question: In Non-Small Cell Lung trials, categorize number of arms as 1-arm, 2-arm, or ≥3-arm.
gt_sql:
SELECT "NCT", "Trial name", "Number of arms" FROM clinical_trials
WHERE "Cancer type" = 'Non-Small Cell Lung';
pred_sql: SELECT "NCT", "Trial name", "Number of arms", "Cancer type" FROM clinical_trials WHERE "Cancer type" = 'Non-Small Cell Lung';
